authority_model.rule: continuity coordinates identity, context, preflight, receipts, commitments, and calendar projections; it never replaces case source truth
authority_model.federation_direction: GlacierEQ/DOCKETS -> Supabase Backend Ops continuity/legal runtime -> Supabase GlacierEQ global projection

providers.email: Gmail or another authorized email provider
providers.calendar: Google Calendar or another authorized calendar provider

loop: read DOCKETS execution object and provider-backed receipts
derive ControlDecision without self-authorizing external action
resolve continuity matter identity using canonical keys, aliases, and strong routes
build fresh context packet containing source-typed facts, recent events, delivery risks, and open commitments
run continuity_preflight_outbound_v2 for stale context, duplicate-action, bounce, and overdue-risk checks
execute provider action only through an explicitly authorized provider path
finish continuity action and write event/receipt/follow-up commitment
project source deadlines and follow-ups into calendar without making calendar authoritative
feed normalized provider receipt back to DOCKETS reconciliation
exchange only frontier hashes, watermarks, counts, operator cursor references, and provider receipt references between Backend Ops and the primary global projection
repeat until lane is terminal, quarantined, or awaiting a source-bound trigger

calendar.rule: deadlines and follow-ups originate in case/continuity commitments; calendar mirrors them idempotently
